faqs.question: How do I convert a photo to black and white online?
faqs.answer: Upload your image, adjust the contrast and brightness sliders to your taste, and click Download B&W Image.

faqs.question: What formula is used for grayscale conversion?
faqs.answer: We apply the standard Rec.709 optical luminance formula: Y = 0.2126*R + 0.7152*G + 0.0722*B, which accurately mimics human eye spectral sensitivity.

faqs.question: Can I adjust the contrast of the black and white image?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can adjust contrast from subtle soft grayscale to high-contrast dramatic monochrome.

faqs.question: Are my private photos uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. All pixel-level matrix conversions occur 100% locally in your web browser.

faqs.question: What image formats can I convert to black and white?
faqs.answer: You can upload JPG, PNG, WebP, and GIF images and export as crisp PNG or JPG.
